entries.name: Kazu
entries.notes: Young stern male, short cropped brown hair, RED scarf, charcoal angular armor with bronze trim. Anatomical LEFT hand carries golden DRAGON-emblem DARK SHIELD; anatomical RIGHT hand carries heavy iron CHAIN ending in a CURVED BRONZE HOOK, not a sword. Preserve the chain and hook in all six views, correct hand grasp, no detached chain. Back shows short hair, scarf around neck/tails, bronze back armor and shield inside. His identity colors stay dark charcoal/bronze/red, NOT blue.

entries.name: Rodoc
entries.notes: Mature muscular man, long brown hair, long gray BRAIDED BEARD, lion-head pauldron on anatomical LEFT shoulder, dark armor with bronze trim, muted GREEN hanging cloth/cape. GREAT STRAIGHT SWORD held correctly in anatomical RIGHT hand; left hand open. Keep asymmetric lion pauldron on correct shoulder through rotations. Rear shows hair, green cloak and lion shoulder. NO shield.

entries.name: EST
entries.notes: Athletic young WOMAN with short asymmetric dark brown swept hair, charcoal armor bronze borders, large layered pauldron on anatomical RIGHT shoulder, bare anatomical LEFT upper arm, muted BLUE hanging cloth and BURGUNDY belt. Curved DAO SWORD in anatomical RIGHT hand, left hand free. Preserve asymmetric armor, feminine identity and hair; no shield.

entries.name: Mask
entries.notes: MOUNTED HERO: male in winged SILVER helmet, silver armor bronze trim, RED scarf and cape, GREY/WHITE horse with BLACK mane/tail, silver face armor, RED caparison. One HALBERD with axe blade plus spear point in anatomical RIGHT hand, left hand holds reins. Horse AND rider rotate together. Include all hooves, tail, complete halberd. No shield, no generic cavalry spear.

entries.name: Soul
entries.notes: MOUNTED HERO: male with long dark brown hair, dark bronze-edged armor, muted GREEN cape. BLACK horse with black mane/tail and GREEN caparison. Huge CURVED GREAT DAO in anatomical RIGHT hand, left hand holds reins. Horse AND rider rotate together. Include full horse, all hooves/tail and full great blade. No spear or shield.

entries.name: Siri
entries.notes: MOUNTED HERO: strong WOMAN, long black hair with braids, silver winged tiara, silver/bronze armor and BLUE cape. BROWN horse, black mane/tail, silver face armor and BLUE caparison. TWO CURVED DAO SWORDS, ONE held correctly IN EACH HAND in every pose, never one sword, no third weapon. Rider AND horse rotate together. Include complete horse and both blades.

entries.name: Xacnas
entries.notes: Mature bearded male, bronze CRESTED HELMET, bronze/dark armor, muted olive GREEN cloak. SHORT recurved BOW in anatomical LEFT hand; right hand near waist. THREE THROWING KNIVES in sheaths on anatomical RIGHT waist/back belt, visibly sheathed not floating. Rear shows back belt knife sheaths around cape. Bow stays SHORT, not a longbow. No shield or sword.

entries.name: Lucy
entries.notes: Female archer, GREEN eyes, dark hair, olive GREEN hood/lower-face scarf, brown leather feather-like shoulder armor, green cloak. LONG BOW in anatomical LEFT hand, ONE realistic straight ARROW inside anatomical RIGHT PALM with fingers naturally curled around its shaft, not piercing hand. Long brown BOWCASE/QUIVER strapped on BACK with visible arrow fletching. Rear angles must show back case. No shield, sword or crossbow.

entries.name: Raen
entries.notes: EXACTLY TWO separate HUMAN HEADS on ONE shared torso with ONE pair of arms and ONE pair of legs, ALL SIX views must preserve this anatomy. Two youthful faces with brown shoulder-length hair, GREEN/GOLD leaf-shaped armor over dark TEAL clothes. ONE CROSSBOW properly held in the two shared hands across torso. Belt/hip-mounted leather bolt quiver visibly filled with feathered CROSSBOW BOLTS. Keep both heads clearly visible even in rear diagonals using small natural head offsets; do not fuse them or make two bodies. No bow, sword, staff or shield.

entries.name: Neuro
entries.notes: Male alchemist, short swept brown hair with a WHITE FORELOCK, charcoal/BRONZE long coat/scarf/shoulder armor. LARGE BROWN BOOK strapped on upper BACK, clearly visible from rear angles. Anatomical RIGHT hand naturally wraps fingers and opposing thumb around the glass BODY of ONE AMBER POTION bottle, no extra fingers or bottle pierced through hand; left hand open. Small amber belt vials. Book stays on back in every pose. No sword, shield, bow or staff.

entries.name: Grim
entries.notes: Female spellcaster, curly reddish BROWN hair, PURPLE hooded cloak with hood up, purple and BRONZE clothing/armor. SHORT golden WAND with amber crystal in anatomical RIGHT hand, left hand at belt. Several CYAN and AMBER potion bottles attached securely around BELT. Rear shows purple hood/cloak and side vials. Keep wand SHORT, never full-length staff; no shield, sword or book backpack.

entries.name: Ranus
entries.notes: Regal female mage, long BLACK hair, winged GOLD crown, gold shoulder armor, BLACK and RED long robes/cape. LONG GOLD STAFF with RED crystal finial in anatomical RIGHT hand; left hand open. Rear shows long hair and red/black cape. Staff correctly grasped and complete in all poses. No shield, sword, bow or generic blue cloth.
